name: b2b-icp-and-customer-insight
description: ICP and customer insight skills for B2B teams by Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting, to decide who your best customers are and how your ICP should change: ICP reviews with metric gaps, customer interview guides and synthesis, fit scoring models and buying role hypotheses.

plugins.name: b2b-icp-and-customer-insight
plugins.description: For B2B founders, product marketers and RevOps: decide whether you sell to the right customers and how your ICP should change. Give it your ICP, customers, deals, interview notes or metrics; get an ICP review, interview guides and synthesis, a fit scoring model with labelled example weights, buying role hypotheses with validation questions, and a check of your product market fit metrics against your own targets.
